dialogue.speaker: Epimenides
dialogue.text: Ah, Alkmaeon... I knew you would come.

dialogue.speaker: Alkmaeon
dialogue.text: You know my name? How?

dialogue.speaker: Epimenides
dialogue.text: I have watched you since you were a child. Your eyes... they see things others cannot.

dialogue.speaker: Alkmaeon
dialogue.text: The dreams... the visions of golden light...

dialogue.speaker: Epimenides
dialogue.text: Yes. The Temple of Apollo on the hill calls to you. It has been sealed for twenty years.

dialogue.speaker: Epimenides
dialogue.text: Dark spirits now guard its halls. But within lies the truth of your past.

dialogue.speaker: Alkmaeon
dialogue.text: My past? What do you mean?

dialogue.speaker: Epimenides
dialogue.text: That is not for me to say. You must discover it yourself.

dialogue.speaker: Epimenides
dialogue.text: When you are ready, venture toward the Temple of Apollo. But be warned...

dialogue.speaker: Epimenides
dialogue.text: The Eidolons that lurk there will not let you pass easily.

dialogue.speaker: Merchant
dialogue.text: Welcome, traveler! Fresh fruits from the orchards!

dialogue.speaker: Merchant
dialogue.text: Hmm, you look like you're heading somewhere dangerous.

dialogue.speaker: Alkmaeon
dialogue.text: The Temple of Apollo ruins. Do you know anything about them?

dialogue.speaker: Merchant
dialogue.text: The Temple of Apollo? *shudders* Stay away from that cursed place.

dialogue.speaker: Merchant
dialogue.text: My brother went there three moons ago. He never returned.

dialogue.speaker: Merchant
dialogue.text: They say shadows walk those halls now. Spirits of the forgotten.
A basket filled with fresh apples and grapes.
The harvest has been good this year.
Beautifully crafted amphorae.
The craftsmanship here rivals that of Athens itself.
The main road through Thespiae.
To the north lies the ancient Temple of Apollo.
Strange lights have been seen there at night...
A crumbling altar dedicated to Apollo.
Faded inscriptions speak of prophecy and memory.
You feel a strange warmth emanating from the stone...

intro: An Eidolon materializes from the shadows!
A spirit of the forgotten dead...
defeat: But this is not the end.
